method: All eight exact files individually viewed after reading source prompts. Five equal-weight editorial dimensions; >=85 overall and >=75 each critical dimension, with independent no-watermark/no-malformed-text finishing hard gates. Anatomy for environments means structural/spatial credibility. Concept-key-art acceptance does not certify playable layout, exact simulation, 3D topology or canon promotion.

images.name: Furnace of the First Breach
observations: The giant sealed furnace wheel, broken suspended lift and tiers of cooling water establish industrial purpose and subsequent failure.
Upper ore rails, damaged middle crossing and lower flooded route give several legible exploration layers.
Cold roof light and contained furnace heat separate water, basalt, timber and metal.
defectsOrLimits: Some distant bridges merge into atmospheric haze; this is route-intent artwork rather than a verified connected level map.
The common foreground explorer-pair framing recurs.

images.name: Sepulchre of the Hollow Choir
observations: Huge sideways ceramic burial chambers create a memorable spatial identity beyond conventional cathedral interiors.
Weathered pale glaze, dark timber bracing, wine-red textiles and warm candles distinguish material and ceremony.
The near chamber entrance, branching escarpment bridges and distant ceremonial tower create layered discovery.
defectsOrLimits: The complete shell profiles are partly occluded; some volumes read as cylindrical funerary vessels rather than flared bells.
Extremely long thin distant supports need structural interpretation in later level design.

images.name: The Thorn Meridian
hardFails: Visible watermark-like floating mark in upper-right sky.
observations: An aqueduct invaded by enormous thorn growth makes environmental conflict and abandoned surveying infrastructure immediately visible.
Rust leaves, green ravine, pale watch platform and morning light sustain luminous adult wonder.
The blocked middle aqueduct and distant secondary bridges suggest meaningful route choices.
defectsOrLimits: A pale floating geometric mark is clearly visible in the upper-right sky above/right of the watchtower.
The image suggests a route network but does not establish every connection around the thorn obstruction.
targetedRepair: Remove only the pale watermark-like geometric mark in the upper-right sky; restore matching natural sky and cloud texture, preserving the tower, foliage and all other composition.

images.name: The Meridian of Ash
observations: A crescent instrument, deep lens well and distant crescent-crowned observatory communicate one specific astronomical culture.
Salt-colored stone, rust sand and eclipse light maintain a strong regional palette.
The near broken causeway, lower well and far bridge separate exploration scales clearly.
defectsOrLimits: The eclipse is an authored monumental sky element, not a verified astronomical scale simulation.
Water in the lower lens well needs an explicit environmental or functional explanation in the dungeon record.

images.name: The Wound Beneath the Stars
observations: A severed stone causeway over reflective dark water gives the environment a consequential exploration problem.
The distant red fissure is an exterior cliff landmark, with no depicted open cosmic prison or Source interior.
Root systems, weathered statues, star reflections and small lantern-lit figures combine dread with quiet wonder.
defectsOrLimits: The stars and water reflection are cinematic rather than an exact optical simulation.
The alternate crossing solution is not shown; it needs authored traversal logic before playable production.

images.name: Bastion of Fallen Suns
observations: Three immense broken concave mirrors create a strong artillery-citadel silhouette.
Exposed ammunition lifts, ramps, snow accumulation and worn military structures show the original operation and present decay.
The repaired wall is plain weathered stone; wayfinding uses simple pictograms and arrows with no malformed lettering visible.
defectsOrLimits: Mirror optical behavior and structural wind loading are not verified by the still.
The highest mirror is cropped, but its full engineering shape is not required for this arrival composition.

images.name: The Winter Reliquary
observations: The malformed left-wall inscription is removed cleanly into consistent worn stone.
The wooden wayfinding retains clear book, doorway and mountain pictograms without English or pseudo-script.
Ice bands, timber ribs, thaw water, scaffolds and layered bridges remain intact and visually legible.
defectsOrLimits: The three sign arrows point toward one initial direction and do not establish the later route split.
The image is a frozen-hub concept; complete progression and ice physics remain implementation work.

images.name: The Blackwake Arsenal
observations: The malformed wall motto is removed, preserving the wet stone and nearby carved figure.
Ship, gear and water pictograms provide local wayfinding without incidental written language.
Suspended hull, staged scaffolds, enormous sea gates and flooded lower passages preserve strong industrial narrative and depth.
defectsOrLimits: Wave simulation, drydock flood control and structural loading are not validated by the cinematic still.
The repeated foreground explorer-pair framing remains an ensemble limitation.
